channel_about.before:
How did ordinary people actually live? Each episode drops you into a real place and year, from medieval London and ancient Rome to Edo Japan, and walks you through a normal day: the work, the food, the rules, and the strange parts that never make it into textbooks.

Every video is researched from historians' books and primary sources, listed in the description, and every claim is checked against its source before the episode is made. Illustrations and narration are made with the help of AI tools; the scripts, research and characters are our own.

New episode every other week. Subscribe and spend a day somewhere else.
